label: BIRC3::MALT1
tumor_contexts: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of MALT

sections.text: BIRC3 encodes cIAP2, an E3 ubiquitin ligase that regulates cell-survival signaling.
MALT1 encodes a signaling scaffold and paracaspase in antigen-receptor-associated NF-kappaB signaling.

The t(11;18) fusion joins BIRC3 BIR domains to MALT1 signaling/paracaspase regions and activates NF-kappaB signaling. It occurs in extranodal marginal zone lymphoma, especially gastric and pulmonary MALT lymphoma.
In gastric MALT lymphoma, t(11;18)/BIRC3::MALT1 is associated with reduced likelihood of lymphoma regression after Helicobacter pylori eradication.
